newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bond yields close lower on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields close lower on ample liquidity.

text.p: South Korea's key bond yields closed lower on Thursday as the cash liquidity remained high at financial institutions, dealers said.
Trading sentiment remained bullish despite news that the note default ratio had hit a 15-year high in April, they said.
The overnight call rate also fell.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.86 pct vs Wednesday's 11.98
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.30 pct vs Wednesday's 12.45
* Average overnight call at 11.69 pct vs Wednesday's 11.81
"Considering that many conservative traders have turned aggressive today, the corporate yields are expected to fall further tomorrow," said Lee Chang-woo of Samsung Securities.
But dealers said profit-taking selling would emerge at around the 11.80 percent level.
